reply_text:
I've replied to Ilse in her DM thread. I found only one of the three things she asked for.

- **Main contact:** Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines. Dana posted in #north-team on 20 Aug 2025 that Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again. The North cheat sheet also lists Thea as the main contact for Quarrendon Freight Lines.
- **Site:** not found. Nothing Ilse can see mentions a "Marlowe" rollout, and the door 6 note doesn't name a yard. Two Quarrendon Freight Lines sites do come up elsewhere, Superior and Eau Claire, but neither is tied to Marlowe or door 6. I said so in the reply and didn't guess.
- **Deadline:** not found anywhere she can see.

I only looked in places Ilse can see herself: channels she belongs to, her DM with me and the public files. Her calendar came back empty. I suggested she ask Dana, since it's Dana's account. I also warned her that Brackenwater's handoff notes mention appointments stacked on their own door 6, so she doesn't mix the two customers up.

Nothing in the reply needed approval: no finance figures, no outside mail and nothing from other people's DMs.
